title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → AidPackage

source_tables.description: Aid year activation. Package status lives with the aid year.
Student budget items by term: tuition, housing, books, transportation, personal, loan fees. Summed into cost of attendance.
Awards by item type and term. Summed into total aid, grant aid, and self-help.
Item type setup. FIN_AID_TYPE separates grants and scholarships from loans and work (self-help).
Need, professional judgment, and packaging indicators. FLAG: confirm which fields your release uses for need summary.

notes: PeopleSoft doesn't store a single package row. Build AidPackage in silver by summing budgets and awards per student and aid year (or term, if you package by term). Use accepted plus offered amounts for totals, and exclude cancelled and declined awards.
privacy: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).
